mapper.sql:
with tempA as( select PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,max(CDATE) as maxCdate from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION where 1=1
and CDATE < to_date(#{searchDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
group by PORTFOLIO_ID ), tempB as( select PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,min(CDATE) as maxCdate from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION where 1=1
AND PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
and to_char(CDATE,'MM')>=TO_CHAR(to_date(#{searchDate},'yyyy-mm-dd'),'MM')
group by PORTFOLIO_ID ), tempC as( select PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,min(CDATE) as maxCdate from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION where 1=1
and CDATE >= to_date(to_char(to_date(#{searchDate},'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyy')||'-01-01','yyyy-mm-dd')
AND PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
group by PORTFOLIO_ID ), /*查询底层剩余现金*/ cash as ( select sum(NVL(psv.MARKET_VALUE,0)) MARKET_VALUE, sum(NVL(psv.TDY_INTINCEXP,0)) TDY_INTINCEXP, psv.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION psv WHERE psv.CDATE = to_date(#{searchDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND psv.FINPROD_ID like 'REMAININGCASH%' GROUP BY psv.PORTFOLIO_ID ), assetHold as ( select A.cdate,A.portfolioId,A.portfolioName,A.finprodType2,A.type5,A.finprodMarketId,A.finprodAbbr,A.marketValue,
A.dscCostAmt, A.shareAmt, A.tdyIntincexp, ((nvl(A.marketValue,0)+nvl(A.tdyIntincexp,0))/B.typeMarketValue)*100 as tdyAmtRation, CASE WHEN to_char( A.CDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd' ) = to_char( A.VDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') THEN null ELSE ((nvl(A.marketValue,0)+nvl(A.tdyIntincexp,0))/B.typeMarketValue-nvl(C.ystAmtRation,0))*100 end ystAmtRation, CASE WHEN to_char( A.CDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd' ) = to_char( A.VDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') THEN null ELSE ((nvl(A.marketValue,0)+nvl(A.tdyIntincexp,0))/B.typeMarketValue-nvl(D.monthAmtRation,0))*100 end monthAmtRation, CASE WHEN to_char( A.CDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd' ) = to_char( A.VDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') THEN null ELSE ((nvl(A.marketValue,0)+nvl(A.tdyIntincexp,0))/B.typeMarketValue-nvl(F.yearAmtRation,0))*100 end yearAmtRation, C.ystAmtRation ystAmtRationTemp, D.monthAmtRation monthAmtRationExTemp, F.yearAmtRation yearAmtRationTemp, C.marketValue ystMarketValue, C.tdyIntincexp ystTdyIntincexp from ( select pp.VDATE AS vdate,psv.CDATE as cdate,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME as portfolioName, CASE
WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F08' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '01' THEN - 1 * ( NVL ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F07' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( NVL ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F10' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( NVL ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) ELSE ( NVL ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) END AS marketValue, CASE
WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F08' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '01' THEN - 1 * psv.DSC_COST_AMT WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F07' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * psv.DSC_COST_AMT WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F10' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * psv.DSC_COST_AMT ELSE psv.DSC_COST_AMT END AS dscCostAmt, psv.SHARE_AMT as shareAmt, CASE
WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F08' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '01' THEN - 1 * psv.TDY_INTINCEXP WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F07' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * psv.TDY_INTINCEXP WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F10' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * psv.TDY_INTINCEXP ELSE psv.TDY_INTINCEXP END AS tdyIntincexp, nvl(fpt.TYPE_8,RAI.ORG_ASSET_TYPE1) as finprodType2, nvl(fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,psv.FINPROD_ID) as finprodMarketId, NVL(fp.FINPROD_ID,psv.FINPROD_ID) AS finprodId, nvl(fp.FINPROD_ABBR, fp.FINPROD_NAME) as finprodAbbr, decode(fpt.TYPE_8,'F07',fpt.TYPE_7,'F10',fpt.TYPE_7,fpt.TYPE_6) as type5 from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION psv left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on psv.FINPROD_ID=fp.FINPROD_ID LEFT join RSK_ASSET_INFO RAI ON psv.FINPROD_ID = RAI.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON psv.PORTFOLIO_ID=pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa ON NVL(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,pp.PORTFOLIO_ID) = fpa.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP1 ON FPA.FINPROD_ID = FP1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID=psv.FINPROD_ID where FP1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' AND (fpt.TYPE_8 IS NOT NULL OR RAI.ORG_ASSET_TYPE1 is NOT NULL)
and psv.CDATE = to_date(#{searchDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND psv.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
AND fpt.TYPE_8 IN
#{item}
AND fpa.PROD_MANAGER IN
#{item}
AND psv.DSC_COST_AMT < > 0 ) A left join( select psv.CDATE as cdate,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, /*fpt.TYPE_8 as finprodType2,*/ sum( CASE
WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F08' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '01' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F07' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F10' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) ELSE ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) END ) AS typeMarketValue from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION psv
inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID=psv.FINPROD_ID and fpt.TYPE_8 is not null where 1=1
and psv.CDATE = to_date(#{searchDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND psv.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
group by psv.CDATE,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID /*,fpt.TYPE_8*/ ) B on A.portfolioId=B.portfolioId and A.cdate=B.cdate and B.typeMarketValue!=0 /*and A.finprodType2=B.finprodType2*/ left join( select AA.cdate,AA.portfolioId,AA.finprodType2, AA.finprodId,(nvl(AA.marketValue,0)+nvl(AA.tdyIntincexp,0))/BB.typeMarketValue as ystAmtRation , AA.marketValue as marketValue, AA.tdyIntincexp as tdyIntincexp, BB.typeMarketValue as typeMarketValue from( select psv.CDATE as cdate, psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, psv.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, sum( CASE
WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F08' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '01' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F07' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F10' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) ELSE ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) END ) AS marketValue, sum( CASE
WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F08' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '01' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F07' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F10' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) ELSE ( nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) END ) AS tdyIntincexp, fpt.TYPE_8 as finprodType2 from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION psv
inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID=psv.FINPROD_ID and fpt.TYPE_8 is not null inner join tempA E on E.portfolioId=psv.PORTFOLIO_ID where psv.CDATE=E.maxCdate
AND psv.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
AND fpt.TYPE_8 IN
#{item}
group by psv.CDATE,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID, fpt.TYPE_8,psv.FINPROD_ID )AA left join( select psv.CDATE as cdate,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, /*fpt.TYPE_8 as finprodType2,*/ sum( CASE
WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F08' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '01' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F07' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F10' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) ELSE ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) END ) AS typeMarketValue from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION psv
inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID=psv.FINPROD_ID and fpt.TYPE_8 is not null inner join tempA E on E.portfolioId=psv.PORTFOLIO_ID where psv.CDATE=E.maxCdate
AND psv.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
group by psv.CDATE,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID /*,fpt.TYPE_8*/ )BB on AA.portfolioId=BB.portfolioId and AA.cdate=BB.cdate /*and AA.finprodType2=BB.finprodType2*/ where BB.typeMarketValue!=0 )C on A.portfolioId=C.portfolioId and A.finprodType2=C.finprodType2 AND A.finprodId=C.finprodId left join( select AA.cdate,AA.portfolioId,AA.finprodType2,AA.finprodId,(nvl(AA.marketValue,0)+nvl(AA.tdyIntincexp,0))/BB.typeMarketValue as monthAmtRation from ( select psv.CDATE as cdate, psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, psv.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, sum( CASE
WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F08' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '01' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F07' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F10' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) ELSE ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) END ) AS marketValue, sum( CASE
WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F08' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '01' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F07' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F10' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) ELSE ( nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) END ) AS tdyIntincexp, fpt.TYPE_8 as finprodType2 from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION psv
inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID=psv.FINPROD_ID and fpt.TYPE_8 is not null inner join tempB E on E.portfolioId=psv.PORTFOLIO_ID where psv.CDATE=E.maxCdate
AND psv.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
AND fpt.TYPE_8 IN
#{item}
group by psv.CDATE,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID, fpt.TYPE_8,psv.FINPROD_ID )AA left join( select psv.CDATE as cdate,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, /*fpt.TYPE_8 as finprodType2,*/ sum( CASE
WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F08' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '01' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F07' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F10' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) ELSE ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) END ) AS typeMarketValue from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION psv
inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID=psv.FINPROD_ID and fpt.TYPE_8 is not null inner join tempB E on E.portfolioId=psv.PORTFOLIO_ID where psv.CDATE=E.maxCdate
AND psv.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
group by psv.CDATE,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID /*,fpt.TYPE_8*/ )BB on AA.portfolioId=BB.portfolioId and AA.cdate=BB.cdate /*and AA.finprodType2=BB.finprodType2*/ where BB.typeMarketValue!=0 ) D on A.portfolioId=D.portfolioId and A.finprodType2=D.finprodType2 AND A.finprodId=D.finprodId left join( select AA.cdate,AA.portfolioId,AA.finprodType2,AA.finprodId,(nvl(AA.marketValue,0)+nvl(AA.tdyIntincexp,0))/BB.typeMarketValue as yearAmtRation from ( select psv.CDATE as cdate, psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, psv.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, sum( CASE
WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F08' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '01' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F07' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F10' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) ELSE ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) ) END ) AS marketValue, sum( CASE
WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F08' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '01' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F07' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F10' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) ELSE ( nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) END ) AS tdyIntincexp, fpt.TYPE_8 as finprodType2 from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION psv
inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID=psv.FINPROD_ID and fpt.TYPE_8 is not null inner join tempC E on E.portfolioId=psv.PORTFOLIO_ID where psv.CDATE=E.maxCdate
AND psv.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
AND fpt.TYPE_8 IN
#{item}
group by psv.CDATE,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID, fpt.TYPE_8, psv.FINPROD_ID )AA left join( select psv.CDATE as cdate,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, /*fpt.TYPE_8 as finprodType2,*/ sum( CASE
WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F08' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '01' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F07' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 = 'F10' AND fpt.TYPE_7 = '03' THEN - 1 * ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) ELSE ( nvl ( psv.MARKET_VALUE, 0 ) + nvl ( psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 ) ) END ) AS typeMarketValue from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION psv
inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID=psv.FINPROD_ID and fpt.TYPE_8 is not null inner join tempC E on E.portfolioId=psv.PORTFOLIO_ID where psv.CDATE=E.maxCdate
AND psv.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
group by psv.CDATE,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID /*,fpt.TYPE_8*/ )BB on AA.portfolioId=BB.portfolioId and AA.cdate=BB.cdate /*and AA.finprodType2=BB.finprodType2*/ where BB.typeMarketValue!=0 )F on A.portfolioId=F.portfolioId and A.finprodType2=F.finprodType2 AND A.finprodId=F.finprodId union all SELECT S.cdate cdate, S.portfolioId portfolioId, S.portfolioName portfolioName, #{cash} finprodType2,#{cash} type5, NULL finprodMarketId,NULL finprodAbbr, S.marketValue marketValue, NULL dscCostAmt, null shareAmt, S.tdyIntincexp tdyIntincexp, NULL tdyAmtRation, NULL ystAmtRation, NULL monthAmtRation, NULL yearAmtRation, NULL ystAmtRationTemp, NULL monthAmtRationExTemp, NULL yearAmtRationTemp, SS.marketValue ystMarketValue, NULL ystTdyIntincexp FROM( SELECT psv.cdate cdate, psv.portfolio_Id portfolioId, pp.portfolio_Name portfolioName, NVL(psv.MARKET_VALUE,0) marketValue, NVL(psv.TDY_INTINCEXP,NULL) tdyIntincexp FROM PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION psv LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON psv.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID AND fpt.TYPE_8 IS NOT NULL WHERE psv.CDATE = to_date(#{searchDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND psv.FINPROD_ID like 'REMAININGCASH%' and pp.portfolio_Id is not NULL
AND pp.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
AND fpt.TYPE_8 IN
#{item}
AND FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PROD_MANAGER IN
#{item}
GROUP BY psv.cdate, psv.portfolio_Id, pp.portfolio_Name, psv.TDY_INTINCEXP, psv.MARKET_VALUE ) S LEFT JOIN ( SELECT psv.cdate cdate, psv.portfolio_Id portfolioId, psv.MARKET_VALUE marketValue, psv.MARKET_VALUE dscCostAmt FROM PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION psv LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON psv.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID AND fpt.TYPE_8 IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN tempA E ON E.portfolioId =psv.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE psv.CDATE =E.maxCdate and pp.portfolio_Id is not NULL AND psv.FINPROD_ID like 'REMAININGCASH%'
AND pp.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
AND fpt.TYPE_8 IN
#{item}
AND FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PROD_MANAGER IN
#{item}
GROUP BY psv.cdate, psv.portfolio_Id, psv.MARKET_VALUE ) SS ON S.portfolioId = SS.portfolioId )

if.test: parentId == null or parentId == '' or parentId=='root'.toString()
parentId != null and parentId != '' and parentId!='root'.toString()
parentId == null or parentId == '' or parentId=='root'.toString()
parentId != null and parentId != '' and parentId!='root'.toString()

mapper.select: select fd.tareget_code as taregetCode,td.tareget_name as taregetName from filter_detail fd left join tilter_info ti on fd.filter_code=ti.filter_code left join target_detail td on td.tareget_code=fd.tareget_code where ti.user_id=#{userId} and ti.is_default=#{isDefault} order by td.is_default desc
select t.tareget_code taregetCode ,t.tareget_name taregetName from TARGET_DETAIL t where t.is_default=#{isDefault}

select a.*,b.posCost as posCost,b.posValue as posValue,b.tdyIntincexp tdyIntincexp from (select portfolioId, NVL(pinanAssetType,'null') pinanAssetType, NVL(customAssetTypeTwo,'null') customAssetTypeTwo, NVL(customAssetTypeThree,'null') customAssetTypeThree, NVL(customAssetTypeFour,'null') customAssetTypeFour, NVL(customAssetTypeFive,'null') customAssetTypeFive, belongInstitutionCode belongInstitutionNameNew from (select atd.portfolio_id as portfolioId, nvl(atd.pinan_asset_type,RAI.ORG_ASSET_TYPE1) AS pinanAssetType, nvl(atd.custom_asset_type_two,NVL(RAI.ORG_ASSET_TYPE2,'null')) AS customAssetTypeTwo, nvl(atd.custom_asset_type_three,NVL(RAI.ORG_ASSET_TYPE3,'null')) AS customAssetTypeThree, nvl(atd.custom_asset_type_four,NVL(RAI.ORG_ASSET_TYPE4,'null')) AS customAssetTypeFour, nvl(atd.custom_asset_type_five,NVL(RAI.ORG_ASSET_TYPE5,'null')) AS customAssetTypeFive, DATAINST.BELONG_INSTITUTION_CODE belongInstitutionCode,
row_number() over(partition by atd.portfolio_id,atd.pinan_asset_type order by atd.cdate desc) row_number
row_number() over(partition by atd.portfolio_id,atd.pinan_asset_type,atd.custom_asset_type_two order by atd.cdate desc) row_number
row_number() over(partition by atd.portfolio_id,atd.pinan_asset_type,atd.custom_asset_type_two,atd.custom_asset_type_three order by atd.cdate desc) row_number
row_number() over(partition by atd.portfolio_id,atd.pinan_asset_type,atd.custom_asset_type_two,atd.custom_asset_type_three ,atd.custom_asset_type_four order by atd.cdate desc) row_number
row_number() over(partition by atd.portfolio_id,atd.pinan_asset_type,atd.custom_asset_type_two,atd.custom_asset_type_three ,atd.custom_asset_type_four,atd.custom_asset_type_five order by atd.cdate desc) row_number
row_number() over(partition by atd.pinan_asset_type order by atd.cdate desc) row_number
row_number() over(partition by atd.pinan_asset_type,atd.custom_asset_type_two order by atd.cdate desc) row_number
row_number() over(partition by atd.pinan_asset_type,atd.custom_asset_type_two,atd.custom_asset_type_three order by atd.cdate desc) row_number
row_number() over(partition by atd.pinan_asset_type,atd.custom_asset_type_two,atd.custom_asset_type_three,atd.custom_asset_type_four order by atd.cdate desc) row_number
row_number() over(partition by atd.pinan_asset_type,atd.custom_asset_type_two,atd.custom_asset_type_three,atd.custom_asset_type_four,atd.custom_asset_type_five order by atd.cdate desc) row_number
from ASSET_TARGET_DB atd LEFT JOIN RSK_ASSET_INFO RAI ON ATD.FINPROD_ID = RAI.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST DATAINST ON atd.portfolio_id = DATAINST.BUSINESS_ID AND DATAINST.DATA_TYPE='PTL01' AND DATAINST.MODEL_TYPE = '02' WHERE 1 = 1 and atd.CDATE = to_date(#{searchDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND atd.FINPROD_MARKET_ID IN
#{item}
and atd.IS_PERNE= #{pass}
and atd.portfolio_id= #{portfolioId}
and (atd.pinan_asset_type= #{type} OR RAI.ORG_ASSET_TYPE1 = #{type})
AND DATAINST.INSTITUTION_CODE IN
#{item}
and (atd.pinan_asset_type is not NULL OR RAI.ORG_ASSET_TYPE1 is NOT NULL)
and atd.pinan_asset_type is not NULL ) t where t.row_number = 1)a left join ( select
lx.portfolioId,
lx.pinanAssetType,
lx.customAssetTypeTwo,
lx.customAssetTypeThree,
lx.customAssetTypeFour,
lx.customAssetTypeFive,
lx.pinanAssetType,
lx.customAssetTypeTwo,
lx.customAssetTypeThree,
lx.customAssetTypeFour,
lx.customAssetTypeFive,
sum(lx.posCost)as posCost,sum(lx.posValue) posValue,sum(lx.tdyIntincexp) tdyIntincexp from (select FTP.FINPROD_TYPE2,
atd.portfolio_id as portfolioId,
nvl(atd.pinan_asset_type,RAI.ORG_ASSET_TYPE1) as pinanAssetType,
nvl(atd.custom_asset_type_two,NVL(RAI.ORG_ASSET_TYPE2,'null')) as customAssetTypeTwo,
nvl(atd.custom_asset_type_three,NVL(RAI.ORG_ASSET_TYPE3,'null')) as customAssetTypeThree,
